title: Time to verified solution: Astra low versus medium versus high (fixed newline serialization)
hypothesis: Reducing Astra reasoning effort reduces end-to-end solution latency without increasing coding, scope or recovery failures.
falsified_if: Lower effort loses correctness, merely shifts work into more tool calls, or misses the registered latency reduction.
local_evidence: User explicitly prioritizes speed of correct solution. This independent screen keeps the current prompt and tools, tests both medium and low against high, and reuses the repaired explicit task scope. Interactive LCA leaves effort unspecified unless selected; high is the pinned experimental control, not an assertion about the endpoint default. Fresh registration after the deterministic tagged-edit trailing-newline fix and compound-command grader repair. The original reasoning campaign never launched. Add repeated_text_edit as a direct regression workload.

task_suffixes.ambiguous_bug_investigation: File scope: change only checkout/cache.py and checkout/service.py. Do not add files.
task_suffixes.multifile_order_cancellation: File scope: change only orders/__init__.py, orders/api.py, orders/models.py, orders/repository.py and orders/service.py. Do not add files.
task_suffixes.failure_recovery: File scope: change only shipping/quotes.py. Do not add files.
task_suffixes.repeated_text_edit: File scope: change only pipelines/rules.py. Do not add files.

deterministic_outcomes: external artifact and original end-to-end hard gates
request-level model, effort, prompt and task contract audits
efficiency_outcomes: time to verified completion, including failed attempts
aggregate coding elapsed milliseconds and per-task medians
failed edits and duplicate-read review candidates
decision_rule: Seed 912. Six independent smoke cells: simple_prompt and ambiguous_bug_investigation across three efforts. Then 30 pilot cells: five scenarios, two repetitions, three efforts. Maximum 36 launches, $8 between-run cost estimate threshold (may overshoot one run), 1800 active worker seconds. No retries or failed-run exclusion. Stop on any smoke task failure or activation/protocol failure. Compare each lower effort against contemporaneous randomized high controls, excluding smoke and arithmetic from primary outcomes. A candidate must have at least as many passes on each of the four coding scenarios, at least 20% lower aggregate coding elapsed time, lower median latency on at least three of four coding scenarios, and no more than 10% aggregate cost increase. If both qualify, select the faster by aggregate elapsed time, breaking ties within 5% by lower cost. No success declaration before completion. Two repeats screen for a candidate, not statistical proof; require fresh held-out validation before default changes. Newline serialization is fixed equally in every arm; original prompt-pilot runs are not controls. Keep current prompt, tools, normal history and model constant. Only effort differs. Record post-fix newline/recovery evidence on repeated_text_edit separately; do not infer a causal speed percentage from the historical before/after comparison.
